document:311520.text: I don't have a lot of time. I'll recount what I can. This place is infested with spiders. Not sure if torches will work on their nests. I've been running for a while... I think I hear them coming... I gotta run!
document:311520.source_cn: 没时间了我尽可能多记一些东西这地方有该死的蜘蛛它们在筑巢结网不知道火把有没有用塔基被拖走了我一路在逃我听到了咔哒声是它们八条腿爬行的声音快跑快跑快跑！！！
